verdict.rationale: Adyen docs confirm configurable payout frequency/currency and reporting with a visual overview of balances, sales, and payouts, giving finance-ops some payout control and visibility. However, there's no direct evidence of a detailed payout reconciliation report breaking down each payout into constituent charges, fees, and refunds. missing for 10: line-item payout composition/reconciliation reports, evidence of fee breakdown per payout, independent/hands-on confirmation of reconciliation accuracy.
